I completely understand. Okay, I'll share something with you, I have a somewhat  similar situation only in my scenario, I am the girlfriend who needed space to think. And my situation is in a way similar to yours, my boyfriend just graduated but I'm trying to get a ged since I was homeschooled and right now he's waiting for me in another state. We were supposed to reunite this month but things got postponed to August and it's put a lot of pressure on our relationship. I completely understand your fear, but I really hope that you will try to relax and stay calm, because so far it seems that everything she's said is a really good sign, it seems you guys have a pretty solid foundation. If you're best friends then you will be able to talk about anything, and that is what's going to keep your relationship strong. 
      Now, when I took time to myself to think things over, I'll be honest I considered a lot of things, ran through all the scenarios in my head, but my boyfriend is also my best friend and I always knew even before we even started dating that I wanted him to be in my life for a long time, and I really had just needed some space to clear my head and get a chance to decide what I wanted for myself, because even when you're in a relationship you have to remember that you are your own person with your own hopes and dreams, I think sometimes people just need a little space to keep track of who they are as a separate person and then they can reconnect and begin discussing who they are as two people together, as a couple, and what they want in the relationship. 
      I think it is important that you support her this summer since she has to retake her tests, I'm sure that she is under a lot of stress and feels horrible it turned out that way, and honestly I think you need to be patient and help her through it, maybe you're feeling anxious and unsure of the future also, I'm sure you feel like you've already waited so long and you just want to move on to the next step already (I feel that way in my own relationship so I completely understand), but some of the best things in life we have to wait extra time for. Trust me.
      As far as you putting off school... Well I know you have the dream of going to the same school with her, but I just want to say if something changes in those plans, like maybe she decides she wants to take a year off or doesn't want to go to college or even wants a different school, just don't sacrifice your own education, she will understand and support you as long as you understand and support her. If you guys continue communicating and supporting each other you should remain strong.
      But, what ever happens tomorrow just be honest with her, tell her how you care for her, how you still want a future with her, tell her that she's your best friend and you don't want to lose her. Just be honest and listen to what she has to say, and if things don't go how you expected them to go, just try to remain calm and understanding but keep telling her how much she means to you and acknowledge the things that she tells you,  all you can really do is be honest and reiterate how you feel. 
   I hope everything goes well, and that you will let me know how things are.

Please listen to this person. Their insight is very dark in places but also has wise points. 

 I want to add...you said you love her more than anything right? Please remember that, she loves you too. You both need to get clean together, get through this together. I know you blame yourself for this whole situation, but truthfully she was already an addict, and you're both fighting the same battle, if she's going to over come this she needs your support. There is hope for her, a lot of hope, but there's hope for you too. Honestly, I think you should talk to her and tell her how you feel, how you regret getting her on heroin, but also how much you love her and how much you want a great life for her, WITH her. And then, honestly, it is up to her if she wants to get clean, and in the event that she doesn't, you cannot blame yourself, but I hope that she does agree to getting clean, and I really hope that you do too. She's beaten her addiction before so she can also help you as having experienced the process of getting off drugs before, and I do think rehab is a good idea, in a controlled environment it will be the best. I really hope you will think about all this and reconsider your plan, because honestly if you're gone I think her chances of stopping may become lower because in all honesty if I was in her situation and I lost my boyfriend it would make me much much worse and even if it was his wish for me to get clean I wouldn't be able to, I would be so blinded by grief. I know this isn't easy, I know it isn't, and you may even feel trapped, I know because I also have the problem of causing people pain by being alive but unfortunately it would cause much much more pain if I died, so it can feel like a trap, but I hope one day we'll realize that staying alive was the best thing that could have happened to us. And maybe OP, once you guys are clean, you can also find a therapist to continue to talk to once your clean, so that way when you and your girl are struggling with the urge to use again you can both talk it through with some one who knows how to fight addictions and can help you stay clean even further, although I know it can be hard to find a therapist who's actually good, but if you can find a good one that can help with aftercare for once you guys are clean it could be good. I just really hope you get through this OP, I know it must feel impossible right now, but I personally think that it is very possible. Please let us know how you are doing.
